source: OSHB morphology + Strong's (prisma/dev.db); patterns per Gesenius' Hebrew Grammar §84–86

statuses.classified: Strong root (or פ״נ/פ״י/ע״ע keeping all root letters), skeleton matches a Gesenius pattern
statuses.assumed-root: No root in Strong's; the form's three consonants were taken as the root and the skeleton matches a Gesenius pattern
statuses.weak-root: Weak root (ע״ו/ע״י, ל״ה, or פ״נ/פ״י/ע״ע missing a root letter): skeleton recorded, not classified yet
statuses.unmatched: Strong root, but the skeleton matches no pattern in the table
statuses.root-not-in-form: The root letters don't appear in order in the form
statuses.no-root: No three-letter root in Strong's derivedFrom
statuses.ambiguous-root: More than one three-letter root in derivedFrom
